stages.detail: The cloud runtime check completed with 16,384 particles and the approved 0.04 m grid. Box settlement occurred at 1.34 s.
All 1,000 unique episodes are uploaded: 776 training, 109 validation and 115 test. Every episode has 251 post-settlement frames. Stored HDF5 size: 125.28 GB; no rejected seeds.
Latest recorded validation: optimizer step 3,500 of 10,000. Training uses 776 episodes and checkpoint selection uses 109 separate validation episodes. See measured curves below.

Verified complete radius graph, remote-body isolation, training/inference parity and Warp state updates. A 250-step recording/evaluation check runs successfully; this is an execution check, not evidence of prediction accuracy.

notes: The CLI submission response timed out, but a separate query confirmed the server started the job. It was not resubmitted.
The local smoke checkpoint is only an implementation test; no trained-model accuracy result is claimed.

Some dynamic-box trajectories reach the rigid ground outside the sand pile. The recorder stores sand-on-box force but not direct ground-on-box force. A large translational force residual is flagged in the metadata rather than treated as a complete contact-force label; episode 456 was checked at its largest residual and its lowest box corner was 4.8 mm below the rigid-ground plane.
